title: viburnum dilatatum f. nikoense
intro: Viburnum dilatatum f. nikoense, commonly known as Japanese Snowball, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, belonging to the Adoxaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, Viburnum dilatatum f. nikoense is believed to have actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and soothe inflammation. The plant contains bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
